jobs.description:
Director, Customer Operations Vendor Strategy & Execution

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We're looking for a senior leader to join the Affirm Global Operations team as the Director, Vendor Strategy & Operations to lead Affirm's global BPO and vendor operations program and serve as a true partner in reinventing how we serve customers at scale across our large global vendor network. This leader owns the customer operations vendor strategy, performance, and outcomes of our global servicing network vendor program — customer experience, compliance, operational excellence, resiliency, and cost-to-serve — across a rapidly growing and complex business. The role will be taking ownership and providing programmatic oversight of the vendor program for operations.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who thinks like an owner, not an administrator. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in fintech and financial-services customer operations and vendor programs with genuine fluency in applying AI and human call center culture to reinvent servicing across the vendor network. They are relentlessly customer-centric, dive deep into both the customer and front-line vendor agent experience, and know how to build a winning combination of culture and data-driven operations across vendors and our internal team. This role is scoped to grow: the right leader will expand into broader operational scope as our transformation matures and play a key leadership role in shaping the future of Affirm Operations and customer centric company culture.

You'll lead a team of Vendor Managers and In-Country Vendor Managers, partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders, and shape the future of Affirm's global servicing network.

What You'll Do

Strategy, Governance & Reinvention

  • Define and execute the long-term strategy for Affirm's global customer operations vendor network, balancing customer experience, operational efficiency, resiliency, compliance, and business continuity across all global vendors.
  • Reinvent how we resolve customer issues and deliver experience across the vendor network, treating the BPO vendor network as an innovation hub rather than a cost center.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance standards, and accountability mechanisms across the global vendor ecosystem.
  • Lead executive-level vendor governance forums, including Quarterly Business Reviews, strategic planning, and escalation management.
  • Partner with Financial Partnerships on vendor selection, expansion, remediation, and network design, evaluating capabilities, geographic footprint, and concentration risk to inform future-state decisions.

AI & Operational Innovation

  • Partner deeply across product, engineering and operations teams to deploy agent and customer facing AI and automation across servicing workflows within the vendor network — agent assist, quality, forecasting, and customer resolution — to reinvent cost-to-serve and elevate vendor agent and customer experience.
  • Bring an experimentation mindset, using AI in everyday problem-solving to reimagine the vendor operating model and program, not just optimize the current one.

Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Own overall vendor network performance across servicing functions, including CSAT, SLA, compliance, QA, productivity, and efficiency outcomes.
  • Build mechanisms for vendor performance management, escalation handling, and vendor accountability, and drive systemic improvements across vendors and functional PODs.
  • Lead recovery efforts for high-risk or underperforming vendor relationships.
  • Drive target cost optimization programs across all global vendors.

Analytics & Decision Enablement

  • Partner with Analytics to define vendor reporting requirements, scorecards, and operational health metrics.
  • Translate operational trends into actionable recommendations for senior leadership, ensuring decisions are grounded in data and measurable outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build a global "one team" mentality that treats the vendor network as strategic partners rather than order-takers.
  • Serve as the primary operational leader for vendor-supported servicing functions, partnering with Product, Engineering, Workforce Management, QA, Training, Risk, and Compliance.
  • Lead large-scale initiatives — vendor migrations, specialization efforts, operating-model transformations, and regulatory implementations.
  • Act as the executive escalation point for complex vendor, operational, and customer-experience issues.

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of Vendor Managers and In-Country Vendor Managers, embodying a customer-centric culture and Affirm's values by example.
  • Establish role clarity, operating rhythms, and performance expectations across the organization.
  • Coach leaders to strengthen analytical rigor, strategic thinking, vendor-management capability, and cross-functional influence.
  • Build a high-performing organization anchored in accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

What we look for

  • 15+ years in customer operations — including large-scale global vendor BPO program management, operations strategy, or consulting for fast-paced, multi-million-customer businesses using vendor networks (or demonstrated equivalent leadership trajectory).
  • 10+ years leading managers and/or complex global operational and vendor organizations.
  • Proven success managing large-scale outsourced operations and global vendor networks across multiple international geographies.
  • Experience leading and optimizing supply and demand management with global work force management teams. 
  • Demonstrated experience deploying AI or automation to improve customer operations or BPO environments at scale.
  • Strong analytical background, using data to drive strategic decisions and operational outcomes.
  • Track record leading large cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.
  • Deep cultural fluency across global geographies — a proven ability to lead and motivate diverse international teams and to build a customer-centric, high-performing culture across varied call-center and BPO environments.
  • Exceptional communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry background in fintech, technology, or financial services, or other high-growth operational environments.
  • Knowledge of consumer facing compliance-heavy functions such as Fraud, Payments, Compliance, or Financial Operations.
  • Experience building operating models, governance frameworks, and scalable service-delivery organizations.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Audio & Voice AI)
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (Audio & Voice AI)

Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.”

At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in production, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics.

**
Role Overview**

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to own the technical journey of our customers and partners, from understanding their problems and proving the value of our technology to integrating it successfully in production.

Sitting between GTM, Product Engineering, and R&D, you will be the technical authority in customer engagements and turn what you learn in the field into product and research input. This is not a role for someone executing an established playbook: you will help create it, operate strategically, and remain deeply hands-on. Speed of response matters here, since a blocked customer is one we can lose. The role is on-site in Berlin.

Tasks

  • Drive customer deployments: Run technical discovery, agree on evaluation and deployment plans, and keep customers and internal teams aligned through production rollout.
  • Demonstrate value: Design and run rigorous evaluations using representative datasets, meaningful baselines and metrics. Turn the results into compelling benchmarks, demos and qualitative examples for engineers and decision-makers.
  • Get customers into production: Move fast. Integrate and configure our technology inside customer Voice AI stacks; write code, debug real-time audio pipelines, validate latency and compute constraints, and resolve SDK issues that block rollout.
  • Build a scalable technical GTM engine: Over time, turn recurring customer work into standardized workflows, tools, reference implementations and documentation so we can evaluate and deploy with more customers without increasing effort linearly.
  • Shape the product from the field: Understand customer problems and identify recurring failure modes, integration friction and unmet needs. Reproduce and structure them into actionable input for Product Engineering and R&D.
  • Support technical communication: Contribute to case studies, product education, technical content, talks, or product launches.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of full-time experience in a technically demanding engineering role, with evidence that you have independently owned complex projects from an ambiguous starting point through a real-world outcome.
  • Hands-on experience with audio, speech, Voice AI, audio DSP, or a closely related field. You can reason deeply about audio systems, evaluation data, model behavior, and the way these affect downstream applications.
  • A master’s degree in a STEM field, such as computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Excellent communication. You can earn the trust of highly technical engineers, explain complex findings to non-specialists, ask incisive questions, and communicate an uncomfortable technical conclusion clearly when necessary.
  • Understanding of production ML systems. You can reason about inference, latency, CPU and memory use, concurrency, streaming state, reliability, and the practical constraints of deploying models in real-time applications.
  • Solid engineering skills. You can quickly understand unfamiliar systems, write clean and reliable code, and build tools and experiments that others can reproduce. Python is required; Rust is a plus.
  • Excellent command of agentic engineering workflows. Coding agents and AI tools are a core part of how you work. You use them to move substantially faster without outsourcing your technical judgment or attention to detail.
  • A product mindset. You look beyond the immediate request, recognize recurring patterns, and distinguish between a customer-specific workaround and an opportunity to improve the product for everyone.
  • A high-agency startup mindset. You are proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities, and willing to do whatever technically credible work is needed to move an important customer or partnership forward.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup, backed by top investors.
  • Compensation and equity: Competitive salary package, additional benefits and stock options, enabling you to take part in the company’s success.
  • Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
  • High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
  • Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
  • Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.

If you are ready to lead the charge in revolutionizing Voice AI and drive our startup to new heights, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join the ai-coustics team!

Product Designer (m/f/x)

UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.



Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

  • Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.

  • Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.

  • Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience with interactive prototyping.

  • Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective

  • Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year

  • Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment

  • Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few

  • Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year

  • Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Director, Site Reliability Engineering

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Site Reliability Team, you'll help build and maintain world-class infrastructure to meet the needs of millions of users protecting their privacy online. You'll utilize high-level languages like Perl, Go, TypeScript, or Python and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Ensuring our Duck.ai product meets our reliability standards and minimizing user friction on failures

  • Scaling up our own index infrastructure to handle billions of documents

  • Create anti fraud verifications that respect users privacy

 

As Director, Site Reliability Engineering, you'll dive deep into complex operational challenges, including software, systems, automation, and process analysis. We are looking for candidates who can read, write, troubleshoot, and deploy all types of software to help us tackle the reliability challenges of large-scale deployments.

 

About You

  • 10+ years relevant professional experience in reliability, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including 4+ years leading SRE teams.

  • Experience participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation for a large-scale deployment.

  • Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact and complex projects from proposal through postmortem.

  • Proficient in AI-driven development, including designing and implementing agentic workflows

  • Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics.

  • Experience developing effective tools, services, alerts, and responses to identify and address reliability risks.

  • Investigative ability to root-cause sources of instability in high-traffic, distributed systems.

  • Deep experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and web technologies.

  • Ability to implement automation around infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to prioritize efficiency, scalability, and reliability.

  • Foresight to help identify the future technical direction of our deployment with the goal of improving reliability and performance.

  • Advanced programming skills enabling close partnership with software engineers to triage production issues and identify appropriate remediation, including code changes and performance considerations.

  • Ability to leverage cloud-native services and architectures to enhance reliability and scalability, with hands-on experience packaging and deploying applications using Docker and Docker Compose.

Compensation

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

jobs.description:
CPO - Chief Product Officer (m/w/d)
Stellenbeschreibung

Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk.

Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt.

Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt.

Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet.

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert.

Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein.

Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team.

Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf.

Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam.

Dein Ziel ist klar:

Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter.
  • Du baust leistungsfähige Teams und Funktionen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette auf – von Strategie und Entwicklung über Beschaffung und Produktion bis hin zu Vermarktung und kommerzieller Steuerung.
  • Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und schaffst eine Organisation, die eigenständig, klar strukturiert und skalierbar arbeitet.
  • Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du die langfristige Unternehmens- und Wachstumsstrategie und übersetzt sie in klare Prioritäten, Strukturen und operative Maßnahmen.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass strategische Initiativen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung effizient, bereichsübergreifend und ergebnisorientiert gesteuert werden.
  • Du optimierst Prozesse mit dem Ziel, Entscheidungswege zu verkürzen, Komplexität zu reduzieren und die Organisation schneller und leistungsfähiger zu machen.
  • Du entwickelst unser internationales Partner-, Produktions- und Lieferantennetzwerk weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Kosten, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Zeitplänen und Rahmenbedingungen.
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere internationale Präsenz, insbesondere in China, weiter aus und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team.
  • Du etablierst klare Qualitäts-, Steuerungs- und Kontrollmechanismen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Standards im Tagesgeschäft konsequent umgesetzt werden.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams die kommerzielle Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche – einschließlich Kosten, Preisen, Margen, Mengen, Zeitplänen und Profitabilität.
  • Du schaffst klare Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass wichtige Initiativen über alle beteiligten Funktionen hinweg konsequent vorangetrieben werden.
  • Du verknüpfst Strategie und operative Umsetzung eng mit Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktkenntnissen und kommerziellem Potenzial.
  • Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren internationalen Teams und Partnern zusammen und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Fragestellungen ein.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung einer multidisziplinären Product Organisation.
  • Tiefgehendes Know-how in Footwear Development, Engineering, Construction, Materials, Fit, Sampling, Testing und Production.
  • Langjährige direkte Erfahrung mit Footwear-Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in China sowie idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk im asiatischen Beschaffungsmarkt.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Sourcing, Costing, Supplier Management, Production Planning und kommerziellen Verhandlungen.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Produktportfolios, Kategorien und internationalen Produktlinien.
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Pricing, Herstellkosten, Volumen, Sortiment und Produktprofitabilität.
  • Du kannst Strategie auf C-Level entwickeln und gleichzeitig operativ tief genug einsteigen, um komplexe Product-, Development- oder Production-Probleme selbst zu verstehen und voranzutreiben.
  • Du bist ein Builder und fühlst dich in einer Organisation wohl, in der Strukturen nicht vollständig vorgegeben sind, sondern von dir geschaffen werden.
  • Du führst mit hohen Standards, klarer Verantwortung und starker Execution.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen schnell, datenbasiert und mit ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Verständnis.
  • Sehr gutes Englisch sowie hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft, insbesondere nach China und zu unseren Produktionspartnern.
  • Standortnähe zu Hamburg beziehungsweise die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort mit unserem Team zu arbeiten.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Echte C-Level Ownership: Du verantwortest die gesamte Product Organisation und damit eine der wichtigsten Säulen unserer zukünftigen Unternehmensstrategie.
  • Build instead of manage: Du übernimmst keine fertige Konzernorganisation, sondern kannst Teams, Strukturen, Prozesse und Verantwortlichkeiten aktiv aufbauen.
  • Direkter Einfluss auf unser Wachstum: Du entscheidest maßgeblich mit, welche Produkte und Kategorien Pammys in den kommenden Jahren entwickelt und skaliert.
  • Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern: Produktentscheidungen werden schnell getroffen und du bist unmittelbar an den wichtigsten strategischen Entscheidungen beteiligt.
  • Internationaler Scope: Du baust unsere Strukturen in China mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit Fabriken, Produzenten und internationalen Partnern.
  • Hohe Geschwindigkeit: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Wenn wir überzeugt sind, setzen wir um.
  • Starkes Fundament: Du baust auf einer Footwear Brand mit über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden auf und gestaltest von hier aus die nächste Wachstumsphase.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eine Product Organisation entwickeln, die auf Geschwindigkeit, Qualität, Profitabilität und internationale Skalierung ausgelegt ist.
  • Executive Package: Ein der Verantwortung, Erfahrung und dem Impact der Rolle entsprechendes Vergütungspaket inklusive leistungsabhängiger Komponenten.
  • Standort Hamburg mit direkter Nähe zu Gründern, Leadership Team und zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen.

Wir suchen keine Person, die eine bestehende Product Organisation verwaltet.

Wir suchen jemanden, der eine baut.

STARK is a defence technology company redefining how autonomous and electronic warfare systems are engineered and deployed. jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher in spatial data management (SDC-36)
jobs.description:
Doctoral Researcher in spatial data management (SDC-36)

GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on January 1, 2027, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Doctoral Researcher in spatial data management
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 75 %, limited to 3 years)
 

The department “Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. “Electoral Spaces” is a project of our team Survey Data Augmentation that develops a research data infrastructure for making geocoded electoral data more findable, accessible, interoperable, and re-usable.


Your tasks will be:

  • Setting up the data storage technology and programming the R interface and auxiliary tools for “Electoral Spaces”
  • Testing and assessing the tech stack to ensure it meets researchers' needs for spatial electoral data
  • Supporting data modeling, data ingestion pipelines, and curation workflows
  • Contributing to technical documentation, project outreach, and dissemination
  • Conducting methodological or applied research showcasing the added value of the infrastructure


Your profile:

  • Master’s degree in geography, geoinformatics, spatial data science, or a related discipline
  • Technical literacy in geospatial software stacks and strong programming skills in R
  • Strong interest in the application of GIS and spatial data to political and social science research
  • Motivation to complete a PhD thesis closely aligned with the project
  • Excellent English language skills


Our Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to a research data infrastructure with substantial impact on the future of democracy research

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Staff Software Engineer, Platform Infrastructure

Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.

About this role

Astronomer’s products run on a complex, multi-cloud platform — and the scalability, and operational maturity of that platform is what we’re actively investing in. The work ahead on our Platform team isn’t about managing data or curating pipelines; it’s about building the foundational systems that everything else runs on — the kind of systems where the failure modes matter, the latency budgets are real, and getting it wrong has visible consequences for hundreds of enterprise customers.

We’re looking for a Staff+-level engineer who has built production platform systems at scale before — not just consumed them. You’ve designed systems under load, reasoned carefully about failure, and made your colleagues’ lives better by giving them something solid and well-understood to build on top of. You write strategy documents and then write the code that proves them out. You’ve been the person who made the call, and lived with the consequences.

This is a foundational role at a consequential moment: your work will directly shape what Astronomer’s products — Astro, Observe, and our IDE — are capable of over the next several years.

What you get to do

Astronomer has a healthy and complex infrastructure estate spanning multiple cloud providers, a mix of managed and self-hosted systems, and an increasingly ambitious set of requirements as our products evolve. We have a clear sense of where we need to go; we need the right person to figure out how to get there and then go build it.

This is very much a technical role — you’ll be just as involved in building these systems as in specifying and designing them. We’re not looking for someone to write strategy documents; we’re looking for someone who writes the strategy and the code, and who has done exactly that before at scale.

  • Blaze a Trail: Own and develop our platform infrastructure strategy, with the sponsorship and responsibility to match. Map out what we need, make the calls, and own the outcomes.

  • Be an Owner: Be directly involved in deciding what we work on and how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.

  • Do Sensible Things: Make principled build vs. buy assessments and advocate for the right tools for the right job — not the fashionable ones, not the ones already in the estate just because they’re there.

  • Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation and decision records for systems and processes. Participate in architectural forums and make principled, open decisions that the rest of the organisation can learn from and hold us to.

What you bring to the role

  • Distributed systems depth, grounded in practice. You have a solid working model of how production systems fail — consistency and availability tradeoffs, failure cascades, backpressure, graceful degradation. You can draw the diagram, explain the failure modes at each node, and make a reasoned argument for which ones actually matter in a given context. NALSD thinking is how you naturally approach a new system design.

  • Kubernetes at operator depth. You know what happens inside the scheduler and the control loop when things go wrong, because you’ve been there. You’ve operated clusters under real load, not just deployed workloads onto them.

  • Strong Go proficiency. The platform team writes production Go. You should be fluent: you’ve built and shipped systems in it, and you have opinions about what good Go looks like.

  • Multi-cloud experience, not just multi-cloud exposure. You’ve made considered architectural decisions across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure — not just consumed managed services, but evaluated tradeoffs between them and lived with those decisions in production.

  • Experience defining requirements and driving technology choices across an engineering organization. You’ve been the person in the room who frames the decision correctly, not just the one who executes it.

  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a design doc that changes minds, and a postmortem that makes the organisation smarter. You’ve worked effectively in a globally-distributed team.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience with storage primitives at the system level — you’ve reasoned about when to reach for a relational store vs. an object store vs. something else, and you have real opinions informed by real failures.

  • Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.

  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration systems.

The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from £135,000 - £185,000, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package. This range is merely an estimate, and the width of the range reflects willingness to consider candidates with broad prior seniority. Actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

 
 

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Entité :

Le Département Bioélectronique du Centre Microélectronique de Provence développe des technologies innovantes à l’interface entre électronique, matériaux et sciences du vivant.

Renforcer les capacités de recherche du Département Bioélectronique avec un postdoctorant capable de développer une nouvelle génération de capteurs optiques organiques flexibles pour l’imagerie calcique.

o   Vous développez et micro-fabriquez des photodétecteurs organiques (OPD) flexibles miniaturisés destinés à la réalisation de matrices multipixels haute résolution.

Software Engineer, Robotics

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

Our autonomy software runs on real programs and real hardware today, and we built it to be platform-agnostic from the start. We're now scaling it onto our own aircraft to field the largest drone swarm in the world. We're looking for Software Engineers, Robotics to build and harden the on-vehicle systems that get us there.

You'll work across the stack: vehicle software, sensor and payload integration, planning behaviors, and simulation. This is the work that decides whether capability survives contact with real hardware in the field.

What You'll Do

  • Build and extend components across our autonomy stack: planning behaviors, vehicle software, sensor and payload integration, and simulation.

  • Grow the on-vehicle software platform into a real integration surface for first and third-party sensors, payloads, and software modules, so new capability drops in instead of getting rebuilt each time.

  • Create and validate physically realistic simulations of UxS, and keep sim honest against what we actually see in flight and field test.

  • Prototype electronics and troubleshoot complex mixed hardware-software systems, including the failures that only show up on real vehicles.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

  • 3+ years building soft-realtime embedded systems or robotics software.

  • Deep expertise in at least one systems language (C/C++, Rust, or Go).

  • Hands-on experience implementing robotics algorithms (path planning, state estimation, behavior trees, etc.).

  • Working knowledge of embedded systems (SPI/I2C/serial protocols, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, microcontroller programming).

  • Strong networking fundamentals (NAT, mDNS, UDP/TCP, multicast, firewall configuration).

  • Excellent software engineering practices with emphasis on testable, reliable code.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to deployed robotics or IoT systems requiring complex edge processing (aerospace, autonomous vehicles, etc.).

  • Experience with robotics middleware (DDS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC) and serialization formats (Protobuf).

  • Hands-on electronics skills (breadboarding, soldering, schematic interpretation, datasheet analysis).

  • Familiarity with government UxS interoperability standards (OMS/UCI, STANAG 4586, FACE).

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

Working hand-in-hand with Account Executives, you'll own everything that happens before the contract is signed — technical discovery, tailored demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and the technical content of RFP/RFI and security responses.

This role is key to converting our largest, most complex prospects — dioceses, regional church bodies, and multi-parish organisations — by proving ChurchDesk meets their functional, security, and compliance requirements. Once a deal is won, you'll partner with the Enterprise Project Manager and CSMs to ensure a clean handover into rollout.

You'll be part of the Enterprise team, reporting to the Head of Enterprise, with monthly 1:1s and weekly check-ins.

About your new role

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects — digging into their current infrastructure, data, and workflows to understand where processes break down, not just what they say they want.

  • Design and build prospect-specific demo environments using their own terminology, structures, and use cases, showing exactly what daily life on ChurchDesk would look like.

  • Own the technical response to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires (encryption, GDPR, hosting, API limits) as the central technical point of contact, working closely with the AE.

  • Secure the "technical win" by getting IT, security, and data-protection stakeholders to formally confirm ChurchDesk meets their requirements

  • Document technical commitments, constraints, and dependencies, and hand over a clean, accurate technical picture to the Enterprise Project Manager and CSM — ensuring what was sold is what gets delivered.

  • Act as the prospect's Trusted Technical Advisor and the deal's technical conscience throughout the sales cycle, giving honest and accurate answers even when it means surfacing limitations early.


Skills & Requirements

  • Proven track record in a pre-sales, Solutions Engineering, or technical sales role, ideally with enterprise or complex B2B deals.

  • Strong technical discovery skills — able to dig into infrastructure, data, and workflows to uncover real problems, not just stated requirements.

  • Hands-on experience building tailored product demos and running proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments.

  • Working knowledge of security, data protection, and compliance topics (encryption, GDPR, hosting, API limits), with the ability to answer RFP/RFI questionnaires accurately.

  • Confident in engaging directly with IT, security, and data-protection stakeholders, building technical credibility and trust.

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with a high degree of integrity — able to translate findings into clear handovers and give honest answers, even when they surface limitations.

  • Fluent in German and English (spoken and written); based in or willing to relocate to Berlin for on-site work.

  • A 37-hour working week – more balance, more time for yourself.

  • An open and honest feedback culture – growing together, learning from each other, communicating transparently.

  • Unforgettable team experiences – from company events to trips to Croatia and Prague.

ChurchDesk has been around for more than 15 years — evolving from a startup into an international company serving customers across Europe. And we’re just getting started!

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Treasury Manager (m/w/d)
Stellenbeschreibung

Du steuerst Liquidität, Cashflow und Finanzierung in einem Unternehmen mit hoher Dynamik.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas.

Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.000 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, Pammys zu einer globalen Footwear Brand zu entwickeln.

Mit steigenden Einkaufsvolumina, internationalem Wachstum und hohen Waren- und Marketinginvestitionen wird professionelles Treasury für uns immer wichtiger.

Deshalb suchen wir einen Senior Treasury Manager (m/w/d), der unsere Liquidität vorausschauend steuert, Cashflow-Strukturen optimiert und dafür sorgt, dass unser Wachstum jederzeit solide finanziert ist.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest unsere Liquiditätsplanung und Cashflow-Steuerung und entwickelst rollierende Forecasts für kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Finanzbedarfe.
  • Du steuerst unser Working Capital und optimierst gemeinsam mit Accounting, Controlling, Sourcing und Operations Zahlungsziele, Bestände und Kapitalbindung.
  • Du verantwortest die Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Finanzierungspartnern und Zahlungsdienstleistern und entwickelst bestehende Finanzierungsstrukturen weiter.
  • Du analysierst finanzielle Risiken und sorgst für ein professionelles Management von Währungs-, Zins- und Liquiditätsrisiken.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Treasury-Prozesse, Systeme und Reportings weiter und schaffst maximale Transparenz über Cash und Finanzierungsbedarf.
  • Du unterstützt Geschäftsführung und Finance Leadership bei Finanzierungsentscheidungen, Investitionen und strategischen Szenarioanalysen.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Treasury, Corporate Finance, Cash Management oder Working Capital Management
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Liquiditätsplanung, Cashflow, Finanzierung und finanziellen Risiken
  • Erfahrung in einem E-Commerce-, Handels-, Consumer- oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmensumfeld ist ein großes Plus
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel sowie Treasury-, ERP- oder Banking-Systemen
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Banken und Finanzierungspartnern
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, vorausschauend und präzise und kannst komplexe Finanzthemen klar auf den Punkt bringen


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Hoher Einfluss: Du steuerst einen der wichtigsten Faktoren unseres weiteren Wachstums: unsere Liquidität.
  • Direkter Management-Zugang: Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Finance Leadership zusammen.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entwickelst unsere Treasury-Strukturen und Finanzierungsprozesse aktiv weiter.
  • Außergewöhnliche Skalierung: Du begleitest ein Unternehmen auf dem Weg vom mittleren 8-stelligen in den mittleren 9-stelligen Umsatzbereich.

  • Du wertest A/B-Tests und Kampagnenexperimente aus und leitest fundierte Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketingaktivitäten ab.

jobs.description:
Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.


About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.
  • Previous team leader or manager role

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)
  • Experience with space systems and concepts

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

Senior Threat Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be a key contributor within NVISO’s Threat Intelligence (TI) team, working closely with colleagues across our DACH and international teams to deliver high-quality threat intelligence services to our clients and to support other teams across the organization. Your work will help organizations better understand their threat landscape, anticipate emerging threats, and respond effectively to real-world adversary activity.

You will contribute across a broad range of threat intelligence activities, including strategic and operational intelligence, sector-specific threat landscapes, and continuous monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources. Your intelligence will support not only incident response engagements, but also other NVISO services such as Managed Detection & Response (MDR) and Red Team operations, enabling detection, response, and adversary simulation activities with relevant and timely intelligence.

You will also contribute to intelligence-led security assessments such as TIBER-EU and TLPT, collaborating with experienced team members to develop realistic threat scenarios and actionable intelligence.

Working in a highly collaborative environment, you will focus on delivering accurate, relevant, and well-communicated intelligence outputs, while actively sharing knowledge and contributing to the continuous improvement of our services and ways of working.

  • Contribute to the delivery of high-quality threat intelligence services across strategic, operational, and tactical use cases.
  • Produce threat intelligence deliverables such as threat landscapes, adversary and campaign analysis, and sector-specific intelligence reports.
  • Perform continuous monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources to identify relevant threats, exposures, and emerging risks.
  • Provide actionable threat intelligence in support of incident response engagements, helping to contextualize attacks and inform response decisions.
  • Support other NVISO teams such as MDR and Red Team by delivering intelligence that informs detection engineering, threat hunting, and adversary emulation activities.
  • Contribute to intelligence-led security assessments (e.g. TIBER-EU, TLPT), supporting threat research, scenario development, and reporting.
  • Support capability-building engagements such as TI maturity assessments, operating model design, and intelligence process implementation.
  • Participate in client-facing meetings and briefings, clearly communicating intelligence findings and insights.
  • Collaborate closely with team members to ensure consistency, quality, and continuous improvement of threat intelligence deliverables and processes.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • 2–5 years of professional experience, including 1–3 years in cyber threat intelligence or a closely related cybersecurity role.
  • Hands-on experience contributing to strategic, operational, or tactical threat intelligence use cases.
  • Exposure to intelligence-led assessments such as TIBER-EU, TLPT, or comparable frameworks is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of threat actors, attacker tradecraft, and intelligence frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK), as well as the intelligence lifecycle.
  • Experience with open-source, deep, and dark web research and monitoring techniques.
  • Ability to work independently on defined tasks and collaborate effectively within a team on larger engagements.
  • Strong analytical and writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured, and high-quality intelligence deliverables.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of current cyber threats, attacker TTPs, and emerging trends.
  • Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH.

Your availability

  • Standard business hours with occasional flexibility required during active client engagements and incident response support.

Travel

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

Als Cloud-Store-Team stellen wir das Framework bereit, mit dem sich standardisierte Deployments auf der OnPrem Cloud Platform (OPCP) automatisieren lassen. Du brennst für Air-Gapped-Cloud-Umgebungen und Edge-Technologien? Dann bist du hier richtig.

Unser Tech Stack 🚀

•Kubernetes •GitOps •Ansible •Terraform •Prometheus

•Grafana •Linux •OpenStack•Python, Bash & Go

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in geocoded electoral data (SDC-34)

GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on January 1, 2027, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Postdoctoral Researcher in geocoded electoral data
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 100 %, limited to 3 years)
 

The department „Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. “Electoral Spaces” is a project of our team Survey Data Augmentation that develops a research data infrastructure for making geocoded electoral data more findable, accessible, interoperable, and re-usable.


Your tasks will be:

  • Leading the development of data curation, validation, and spatial aggregation tools for geocoded electoral data using the statistical software R
  • Establishing a framework clarifying legal, ethical, and licensing conditions for data provision and reuse
  • Supporting the principal investigators in coordinating the overall project and managing workflows and project knowledge
  • Creating user documentation, training materials, and public interfaces for the infrastructure
  • Conducting methodological or applied research showcasing the added value of the infrastructure


Your profile:

  • Completed academic university degree (Master’s or equivalent) and completed PhD in political science, quantitative social science, spatial data science, or a related discipline
  • Advanced expertise in longitudinal and spatial data integration, provenance documentation, and reproducible workflows
  • Proficiency in coding and managing spatial datasets in R, with experience in version control and data curation standards
  • Track record of contributing to empirical research and generating scientific innovation with data infrastructure
  • Excellent English language skills


Our Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to a research data infrastructure with substantial impact on the future of democracy research
  • Work in an integrated yet flexible team of quantitative social scientists with substantial synergies between survey augmentation projects specializing in geospatial data applications and democracy
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working
  • Very good conditions for reconciling work and family life, e.g. subsidies for childcare for children who have not yet attained the age of compulsory schooling
  • Holistic company health management and discounted participation in the university's sports programme 
  • Generous support for your pension provision as a direct insurance policy
  • Promotion of your skills through further training measures


Contact

For further information concerning the tasks please contact Sebastian Ziaja via E-Mail ().  If you have questions about the application process, please contact Christine Laßmann via E-Mail ().


Interested?

Please apply by submitting a motivation letter, a CV, and a writing sample via our online-application portal until October 2, 2026.

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Your mission

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to help us build a faster, and more reliable testing and release processes for one of our latest product engineering teams. You will work closely with Software and Machine Learning Engineers to establish the quality foundations for a product characterised by dynamic, non-deterministic outputs.

The team is a newly formed multidisciplinary team of 5 responsible for the conversational AI components across our WebApp. As the team’s founding Quality Engineer, you will play a central role in defining how we approach quality from the outset. You will introduce thoughtful, pragmatic practices that increase confidence in releases, reduce remediation and rollback work, and enable the team to move quickly without compromising user trust or product reliability.

You will have meaningful ownership from day one: exploring testing approaches, identifying quality gaps, and helping shape the systems and processes that support sustainable delivery. This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in ambiguity, combines hands-on technical testing with experimentation, and wants to define quality engineering at the intersection of software development and LLM-powered products.

Part of your day-to-day

  • Develop and evolve quality practices, test strategy, and release processes for the Chatbot product.

  • Help establish and run an output-evaluation framework for assessing Chatbot quality, reliability, and regressions.

  • Test dynamic and non-deterministic LLM-based systems, designing pragmatic approaches for validating behaviour beyond conventional deterministic test cases.

  • Identify, test, and improve guardrails for AI-specific risks, including prompt-injection scenarios and unsafe or unexpected model behaviour.

  • Partner with engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and collaborative debugging to improve quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

  • Investigate current testing gaps, research relevant methods and tools, and make evidence-based recommendations to the team.

  • Design proof-of-concepts for new testing approaches or tooling, then help productionise the solutions that create the most value.

  • Support the evolution of release testing, including clearer quality signals and release-readiness criteria.

  • Contribute performance-testing thinking for LLM-powered workflows where relevant.

  • Share knowledge, facilitate technical discussions, and build the Quality Chapter across the wider engineering organisation.

 

Requirements / What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience in software quality engineering, SDET, test automation, or a closely related engineering role.

  • Experience testing chatbot, conversational AI, RAG, LLM-powered, or other systems with dynamic and non-deterministic behaviour; even early practical exposure is valuable.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language and enough technical depth to understand production code, contribute to code reviews, and collaborate effectively with software engineers.

  • An experimental, investigative mindset: you can explore an uncertain problem space, assess alternatives, and turn findings into practical improvements.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts, testing risks, design choices, and trade-offs.

  • Strong collaboration skills and a pragmatic approach to working with Product, Engineering, and ML colleagues.

  • Good judgement in prioritising quality work based on risk, user impact, and delivery goals.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI security and safety testing.

  • Experience testing conversational AI, chatbot platforms, or agentic workflows.

  • Experience as the first Quality Engineer in a team.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or influencing testing practices across a cross-functional team.

Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois

Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses :
Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026

Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois
Description de poste ici
Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.description:
Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content

About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar
